entities.summary: Vladimir Yakovlevich Tsesler is a Soviet and Belarusian artist and designer. His work spans poster art, painting, graphics, sculpture, industrial and print design. He is best known for his posters. Tsesler lived and worked in Minsk; since 2020, he has resided in Cyprus.
